blocks.lead: Build the page from blocks. Each block has English and Arabic text; Arabic is optional and falls back to English.
blocks.fix_errors: Some fields need fixing before the page can be saved.
blocks.empty_text: Add a hero, text, pictures, questions or a list of programs below.
blocks.hide: Hide this block on the website
blocks.preview_bar: Preview — only staff can see this page like this

desc.features: Cards with an icon, title and text
desc.faq: Collapsible questions (shown in Google and AI answers)
desc.programs: Live programs filtered by country, degree, field

lines.features_items: One card per line: icon | title | text (icon optional, e.g. plane | Visa support | We prepare your file)
lines.stats_items: One per line: number | label (e.g. 1,200+ | students placed)
lines.gallery_images: One per line: image address | caption (choose from the media library and copy its address)

home_sections.title: Sections and order
home_sections.lead: Show, hide and reorder the home page sections and give them your own titles. Empty titles use the default text.
home_sections.page_unpublished: This page is not published, so its blocks are not shown.
home_sections.add_hint: Build a page with the page builder (it can stay unpublished as a page if you only want it on the home page — publish it to show the blocks), then add its blocks here.
